title: Cute Theme
text: Cute Theme. I love decorating my tiered tray for the different seasons and months. This is a cute, summer theme. There's a nice variety of decor items in this set. While they are mass produced, they don't "scream" mass produced. There were a couple of items that had flaws such as smeared ink or streaks. I included a picture of one. But in all honesty, I am not unsatisfied with that and I think it makes it look more realistic and natural.
